scope_note: ERC-20 governance/staking token, native to Ethereum, CCIP lock-and-mint on BSC (BSC share = lockbox balance 44.72%). Not wrapped/staked; listed on Binance since Jan 2024. Circulating = CoinGecko 7,607,986,107 (= 10B minus vesting Safe balance, consistent on-chain).

D1.value: Ethereum top-9 non-excluded (lockbox excluded) = 55.8% of circulating, incl. owner Safe 31.44%. Even without the Safe ~24.4% from 8 wallets plus unseen #11+; BSC top-10 (69.4% per prior GeckoTerminal) not labelled.

D2.value: Owner Gnosis Safe 0x12a6...b1c0 holds 2,392,013,893 ALT = 31.44% of circulating; it's a 2-of-3 Safe, not a vesting/timelock contract with on-chain schedule, so not excluded. Largest other: 0xf721 EOA 7.21%.

D3.value: Liquid insider: owner Safe 31.44% + D5 unidentified >=2% wallets (0xf721 7.21, 0xeb79 4.72, 0x21d9 4.10, 0x5240 2.14, 0xa312 2.09) = 51.7% > 20%. Without the Safe still 20.26%.

D4.value: Insider-to-exchange flows over 90 days not traced

D5.value: Five unidentified wallets >=2% of circulating (0xf721, 0xeb79, 0x21d9, 0x5240, 0xa312); counted as insiders, changes D3 result

E1.value: 2026-11-25 unlock 240.8M ALT = 3.17% of circulating (>= 2%). Vesting Safe still holds 2,392,013,893 (unchanged since prior), consistent with monthly 240.8M releases on the 25th.

E2.value: Next 180 days: ~6 monthly unlocks x 240.8M = ~1.445B = 19.0% of circulating (<=20%, close to the limit; staking rewards not added, could push over). Treat as borderline.

E4.value: Monthly schedule to 2028-01-25 published (tokenomics.com) and matches on-chain Safe outflows

F2.value: mint(to,amount) onlyOwner, ERC20Capped(1e28) and totalSupply already = cap, so no mint now; but ERC20Burnable burns reopen headroom mintable by a 2-of-3 Safe without timelock. GoPlus is_mintable=1.

F3.value: Owner = Gnosis Safe 0x12a6...b1c0, 3 owners threshold 2 (0x834f..f216, 0x065a..a81c, 0x5f17..8df7), no modules, guard slot 0, no timelock; holds pause() over all transfers and capped mint. Not an EOA, but no >=48h timelock. GoPlus owner_address=Safe, can_take_back_ownership=0.
F3.source: publicnode eth_call getOwners/getThreshold/getModulesPaginated, eth_getStorageAt guard slot; GoPlus

F5.value: ERC20Pausable: owner can pause() all transfers (currently paused()=false). Held by 2-of-3 Safe without timelock: not F3-grade (at minimum need-more-info). GoPlus transfer_pausable=0 and is_blacklisted=0 understate this.

F6.value: No tax/limit code; GoPlus buy_tax=0 sell_tax=0 slippage_modifiable=0

F8.value: DEX pools / LP locks not checked
